context_requirements: Functional GABAergic signalling machinery, including GABAA receptors and/or GABA transporters, which is not a documented feature of these nine cell lines
Expression of SLC6A1 (GAT1) or other GABA uptake transporters at levels sufficient to modulate extracellular GABA
A neuronal or neuroendocrine lineage context; the panel is melanoma, lung, liver, colon, breast and prostate lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls and not explained by generic stress or proliferation
Evidence of GABA transporter or GABAA receptor expression and functional coupling in these lines
